title: Test-only controls visible in the real app
recommendation: Hide 'Simulate sync failure' and 'Go offline' behind a developer flag.

title: Destructive Delete sits in the scan flow
recommendation: Move Delete and Mark wrong behind a menu with confirm, away from Correct.

title: Your counts table is too heavy (13 cols, 4 actions)
recommendation: Compact default view; reveal extra columns per row on demand.

title: Floating 'N' badge overlaps table content
recommendation: Reposition or remove the floating widget.

title: Export menu labels are truncated
recommendation: Widen the export menu or wrap labels.

title: Login does not say what the app does
recommendation: Add a one-line value prop on the login card.

title: Low-contrast status line and error banner
recommendation: Raise contrast to WCAG AA; confirm colorblind-safe status colors.

title: Unknown-scan error banner persists after action
recommendation: Auto-dismiss or soften the banner once the item is queued.
